verdict.rationale: llamafile is a single-file local LLM runtime with a CLI mode and an HTTP server, so it runs workloads and a scheduling question is fair to ask. Nothing in the evidence documents any built-in way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows; all scheduling would come from external OS tools, which earns no credit. The only cited material is the run modes (one-off CLI prompts and an on-demand server), which shows how jobs are launched, not that they can recur on a schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
